remarks: Beautifully Renovated Condo in a Prime Downtown Greenwich Location. Nestled in the heart of Greenwich, atop the renowned Greenwich Avenue, this stunning south-facing, sunlit 1-bedroom condo offers an open layout that has been meticulously maintained. The extensive list of improvements includes major upgrades such as refinished original oak floors, a brand-new eat-in kitchen with LG appliances and Carrera Quartz countertops, and a luxurious spa-like bathroom with Kohler fixtures. Attention to detail is evident with refinished original hinges, new window weatherstripping, and updated outlets and light switches. The Greenwich Lodge Association offers amenities like a rooftop deck with city and water views, an on-site full-time superintendent, and a convenient central location. Parking and storage are included.
